column1: # Expected outcome of tests/e2e/tests/legacy_file_key_store.rs when only the
# production code is reverted to the base commit. "defect" rows reproduce the
# reported failure; "observable" rows fail only because the base has no
# selection log or source record; "protection" rows already pass on the base.

observable: the base also fails to start but never names the unreadable store
observable: the base ignores the record and fails only for the missing service

observable: the base selects the same store but records no source
observable: the base recovers the same way but records no source
observable: the base records no source, so no confirmation exists to keep
